claims: The actual pinned public-software probe passed 1,024 contiguous-buffer mappings and 1,024 authored TTE DMA-chain mappings, each comparing the full 16KiB VU data memory at all TOPS values; qword3.Z contained authored label15.

In this tested public parser, separating the 8-byte NOP+UNPACK prefix from its 80-byte payload into chunks80/16/4 left VU data memory untouched in 3,072 cases. The authored TTE DMA chain supplied a coalesced buffer and passed, so these results alone do not show that original-game DMA chains fail.
The probe's TTE-cleared negative control failed the mapping in all1,024 cases, and clearing the TOP-relative flag changed1,023 mappings while TOPS0 remained equivalent. No VU execution callbacks ran.
The original game's actual DMA/VIF stream loses its five-qword geometry header because of this fragmentation behavior.
